newsitem.title: USA: Ancor auditors no longer have "concerns".
newsitem.headline: Ancor auditors no longer have "concerns".

text.p: Ancor Communications Inc said Friday its independent auditors no longer had concerns about the company's ability to remain a going operation.
In an amended 10-K filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the auditors removed their previously expressed concerns, the company said.

The filing followed Ancor's recently completed $8.55 million private placement of five percent convertible preferred stock, and reflects Ancor's strengthened financial position following completion of the offer, the company said.

Last month Ancor said its auditors had raised questions about the company's ability to continue as a going concern. Ancor said at the time that it planned a private placement of up to $10 million of five percent convertible preferred stock.

Ancor said today that proceeds from the offering were being used to continue its expansion in the Fibre Channel market. It said it has averaged 43 percent annual compound ground in Fibre Channel product sales over the past three years.
Ancor's products include Fibre Channel adapters, routers and application-specific integrated circuits.
